competitor_advantages.point: Loman AI claims restaurants using its product see, on average, a 26% increase in phone-order revenue and a 23% higher average ticket size, plus 99.6% order accuracy which it describes as industry-best.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Loman AI is a phone-ordering voice-AI agent with direct POS integrations across Toast, Square, Clover, Aloha, Olo, and Stream, competing on flat (non-per-minute) pricing.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's phone/voice-ordering and kitchen_drive_thru capture surface; POS-agnostic integration model means it can be adopted regardless of which POS (including Genius/Aloha-descended systems) an operator runs.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No disclosed funding round or named enterprise customers found; product and pricing pages suggest an SMB/independent-operator go-to-market model as of research date.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect cites Loman's 26% phone-revenue-lift or 99.6% accuracy claims, note these are vendor-reported and ask whether they've seen an independently verified case study from their own segment.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, leadership, or funding history found in sourceable material; all performance statistics are vendor self-reported.

verification_needed: operator ROI evidence beyond vendor claims
